answer.answer: Only two location clusters satisfy both the 50 km and 1-year constraints: the three Kalangutkar et al. (Goa, India) samples and the Caldwell et al. 2019/2020 (Corsica) pair, giving four independent-study comparisons with factor ratios of 1.72, 2.35, 4.05, and 7.77. The median of these four factors is about 3.2x.
